title: Number of Police Patrols Deployed at Little India on Weekends
what_it_is: Number of Police Patrols Deployed at Little India on Weekends

sections.label: Little India police deployments
sections.summary: Police deployments in Little India are confidential, based on law and order assessment, with unchanged levels over three years and cameras increased from 34 in 2016 to about 200 today.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Police operational deployments are confidential and are driven by an assessment of the law and order situation.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police deploy a significant number of Auxiliary Police Officers and Security Officers to patrol Little India during peak periods such as weekend nights, eve of Public Holidays and Public Holidays.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The level of deployment has not changed over the past three years.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police have also deployed cameras within Little India to supplement the ground patrols.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: We have steadily increased the number of cameras, from 34 in 2016 to about 200 today.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Home Affairs (Mr Amrin Amin) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Police’s assessment is that the current deployments have kept the crime situation in Little India in check.

sections.label: Patrol deployment plans calibrated
sections.summary: Patrol deployment plans are calibrated by crime trends and crowd footfall, covering common areas and specific concerns including HDB higher floors and staircase landings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: Patrol deployment plans are calibrated based on the crime trends as well as the crowd footfall.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: We note the Member's feedback but just to let the Member know, the patrol team does patrol common areas as well as specific areas of concern.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: This includes the higher floors and staircase landings of HDB blocks where there is specific feedback about congregations or dis-amenities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Amrin Amin
sentences.text: If the Member has specific feedback in terms of the block or the areas with such congregation, he can share it with the Police and the Police will certainly look into it.
